title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
version: 2026-06-03 reconstructed work-level readers, al-Battani v083 text, and complete fixed-star catalogue
description:
Working corpus of modern LaTeX readers and translations for selected non-European mathematics manuscripts and historical mathematical texts. This satellite record is intentionally reader-facing: readable top-level PDFs come first, followed by compact TeX/source artifacts and current work packets. Large raw source drops, page-image working archives, superseded drafts, and broad provenance bundles are preserved on the main project landing and bulk-preservation record instead of being re-uploaded here on every update.

Status at a glance. [#########-] front-facing reader set: reconstructed work-level PDFs and combined readers are current; [##########] al-Battani text stream: segments 1-100 are promoted as a trilingual Arabic/English/Chinese reference reader; [##########] al-Battani fixed-star catalogue: complete critical table edition with 485 stars, authoritative ecliptic longitude/latitude values, magnitudes, north/south signs, and modern Bayer/Flamsteed identifications; [##--------] remaining al-Battani numerical table stream: chronology, geography, zodiac, and auxiliary tables remain active reconstruction work.

Current update. Replaces the earlier descriptive al-Battani catalogue with a complete fixed-star catalogue edition and coordinate dataset. The existing reconstructed non-Battani work-level release and al-Battani v083 trilingual text/reference packet remain the current broader reader surface.

Source and provenance layout. Project-generated TeX and compact current work artifacts are attached here. Full raw/provenance preservation is maintained on the main project record, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20393488, so this record can be updated without repeatedly moving multi-gigabyte working archives.

Workflow provenance: public-domain or openly available source witnesses are transcribed into TeX, translated where useful, checked locally, and published with artifacts so readers can inspect and improve the work. The default licensing target for project-generated transcription and translation layers is CC0 where legally available.
notes: Latest update replaces the earlier descriptive al-Battani fixed-star catalogue with a complete critical catalogue edition and coordinate dataset: 485 stars with authoritative ecliptic coordinates and modern identifications. Text segments 1-100 remain complete in the v083 trilingual reader; chronology, geography, zodiac, and auxiliary numerical tables remain in progress.
